summary.text: Doug Smith is a Republican member of the West Virginia House of Delegates from District 39, listed with Mercer County. His legislative page lists him as vice chair of the Government Organization Committee.

paragraphs.text: Smith's page lists a B.S. in criminal justice from Wichita State University, a master's in public administration in criminal justice from City University, and a Master of Strategic Studies from the U.S. Army War College.
It lists his occupation as retired Army colonel and military police officer and gives his birthplace as Waterloo, Iowa.

His affiliations include the National Rifle Association, the Veterans of Foreign Wars (life member), the Military Officers Association of America, the North American Hunting Club (life member), Bluefield Mercer Lodge No. 85 and the West Virginia Citizens Defense League.
Smith also serves on the House's Health and Human Resources and Health Care Regulation committees.
